candidates.title: Devops Engineer at 360Learning
candidates.description: As a DevOps Engineer, you will be an integral part of an existing team comprising sixseven DevOps professionals. You will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and the internal platform built on it, which serves over 1800+ client companies, with 2.5+ million registered users and 30,000 daily active users.  You will collaborate closely with all engineering squads including Development, Architecture, AI, and Data teams, to ensure the smooth and efficient delivery of our SaaS product. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. Your expertise will be crucial in driving continuous improvement and fostering innovation within our DevOps and Platform Engineering practices. You will have the opportunity to: - Make a tangible impact in a rapidly evolving company. You will be responsible for building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure (accommodating more developers, more customers, and expansion into more countries) while optimizing resources (monitoring costs, reducing toil, and improving time to market) to support our growing activities. - Engage in the continuous enhancement of our practices and undertake challenging and comprehensive projects. candidates.title: Lead Talent Acquisition EMEA at Pelico
candidates.description: About PelicoTraditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide.
